patches.name: Unlock Premium
patches.description: Unlocks AT4K Launcher's premium features without paying, like more apps per row and the premium wallpaper options. It all runs on the device, so nothing stays locked.

patches.name: Unlock Plus
patches.description: Unlocks Sparkle TV's Plus features without purchase, including DVR recording, timeshift, multiview, VOD (movies & series), multi-source setup, and custom channel/category editing.
